'''Callonia''' was an object<ref name="CP" /> located in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|proclamation]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Fakir sector was a relatively unimportant region of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space located near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. There were several hundred [[Planet/Legends|planets]] suitable for habitation in the sector; approximately 50 of them contained [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] life-forms, of which perhaps 10 had achieved the level of technology necessary for [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other «common» [[Species/Legends|aliens]] had [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] about 150 planets in the sector.<ref name="CP" />

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">"[[The Long Shot Campaign]]" as described in the ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' takes place "shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]." This event was established to have occurred in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]], ''[[Long Shot]]'', originally belonging to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], was stolen by [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] at [[Callonia spaceport]].<ref name="CP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Callonia was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', a gamemaster accessory written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1988]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CP" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Callonia system/Legends|Callonia star system]] in grid square K-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
